messages:
Ana: Quick heads-up — we rolled out two procurement changes that go live Monday. Please read and flag questions. :loudspeaker:

Ana: 1) Vendor onboarding now requires the new self-service form (link below). 2) One-off purchase threshold raised to $3k for individual contributors; purchases above that need vendor pre-approval and a PO.

Ana: Link to portal: <https://redwood.internal/procure|procurement portal> — use the 'vendor onboarding' flow for new suppliers.

Trevor: Nice. Is the $3k threshold per invoice or per vendor per month?

Ana: Per invoice. If you foresee recurring spend that will exceed $3k/month, submit a vendor approval request and indicate expected cadence.

Marta: Heads-up for folks managing interviews/hiring — background-check vendors still need security review even if under $3k.

Ben: If I'm buying a SaaS tool for a single project for $2.8k, do I still need a PO?

Ana: No PO required under $3k, but submit the one-page vendor form so we have basic contract and tax info on file. If procurement flags security or legal items, we'll follow up.

Trevor: Where do managers sign off? I assume expense owners still need manager approval in Concur?

Ana: Yes — Concur approvals remain. Quick checklist: manager approval in Concur + vendor form submitted = good for <$3k.

Ben: Got it. Any changes to corporate card limits?

Ana: Corporate card limits unchanged. This is about AP/PO and vendor onboarding.

FinanceBot: Automated reminder — vendor form submitted successfully for "KiteAnalytics" by Ben at 1795556899. Reference ID: VND-2026-324.

Ben: Thanks FinanceBot — FYI I uploaded contract draft in the portal.

Ana: For any emergency purchases outside normal flows, tag @finance and include "EMERGENCY" in the subject along with business justification and expected spend. Procurement will triage within 4 hours during business days.

Marta: Can we get a one-pager summary for People Ops to circulate in onboarding?

Ana: Yes — I'll drop a short FAQ and a flow diagram to the docs site by Friday.

Trevor: One more: vendor exceptions — who signs?

Ana: Director-level signoff required for exceptions between $3k and $25k. Anything above $25k goes through FP&A and legal review. We'll publish the signoff matrix in the portal.

Ben: Appreciate the clarity :thumbsup:

Ana: Thanks all. Ping me or @finance if you hit edge cases.
